# Core Nodes, stations (census #65-#69): tap-to-assign C11, drag-drop C12, the per-spot part
# picker C13, the shared-window part checklist C14. static/pages/loaders.js run as served over
# the page's tiles (every node but _TRANSIT; group and lane tiles absorbed into group cards).
# Stations: UNL-A (shared windows; window GRP-A-L1-S1; fulls from GRP-B; part PART-B),
# LDR-B (one spot per part; GRP-B-N2 holds PART-C; empties from GRP-A).

== page load (init)
  GET /api/bin-types
  GET /api/nodes
  GET /api/payloads
  GET /api/loader/list

== refresh() re-reads /api/nodes, /api/payloads and /api/loader/list; called 15 times, from:
  submitLoader, saveWindowCap, addLoaderQuota, setLoaderQuota, removeLoaderQuota, saveStationSetting, deleteStation, appendWindow, appendWindow, assignPlace, onBoxDrop, setMemberPayload, removeMember, savePayloads, init

== armed: UNL-A Windows; the grid as decorated (assignReason via decorateGrid)
  bar: "Adding a window — tap a node. Greyed nodes can’t go here."
    tile  GRP-A          (absorbed) dim "a group can’t be a window"
    tile  GRP-A-L1       (absorbed) dim "a group can’t be a window"
    tile  GRP-A-L1-S1               current "already a window"
    tile  GRP-A-L1-S2               lit "tap to add"
    tile  GRP-B          (absorbed) dim "a group can’t be a window"
    tile  GRP-B-N1                  lit "tap to add"
    tile  GRP-B-N2                  dim "window of LDR-B"
    tile  LINE-1                    lit "tap to add"
    tile  SPOT-9                    lit "tap to add"
    tile  _ROBOT:AMR-01             dim "a group can’t be a window"
    tile  OLD-SLOT                  lit "tap to add"
    tile  VIRT-1                    dim "a group can’t be a window"
    tile  GRP-OFF        (absorbed) dim "a group can’t be a window"
    tile  GRP-OFF-N1                lit "tap to add"
    group GRP-A                     dim "a group can’t be a window"
    group GRP-B                     dim "a group can’t be a window"
    group GRP-OFF                   dim "a group can’t be a window"

== armed UNL-A "Empties go to", Find "grp-b": what the filter hides
  GRP-B, GRP-B-N1, GRP-B-N2, GRP-B (header) stay; the rest are filtered
  (no request)

== tap to assign: the requests, in order (each write is followed by the re-read)
-- UNL-A "Empties go to", tap the GRP-A header (one update, then refresh)
  POST /api/loader/update {"id":20,"name":"UNL-A","layout":"shared_window","replenishment":"operator","funnel_windows":false,"accept_partials":false,"auto_push":false,"drain_states":[],"fed_directly":false,"pulled_directly":false,"board_hides_idle":false,"board_shows_all_parts":false,"no_clear_partials":false,"inbound_source":"GRP-B","outbound_dest":"GRP-A"}
  GET /api/nodes
  GET /api/payloads
  GET /api/loader/list
  armed after: null
-- UNL-A Windows, tap LINE-1 (set-home, reorder with it last, then refresh)
  POST /api/loader/set-home {"loader_id":20,"position_node_id":8,"payload_code":"","home_kind":"home","uop_threshold":0}
  POST /api/loader/reorder-homes {"loader_id":20,"ordered_ids":[3,8]}
  GET /api/nodes
  GET /api/payloads
  GET /api/loader/list
  armed after: {"loaderID":20,"slot":"windows"}
-- UNL-A Windows, tap _ROBOT:AMR-01 (dimmed: a tap does nothing)
  (no request)
-- UNL-A "Fulls come from", tap GRP-B (already here: dimmed as current)
  (no request)

  GET /api/loader/list

  GET /api/payloads
  GET /api/loader/list
-- drop the GRP-B header on UNL-A's box
  (no request)
  toast warning: a group can’t be a window
-- drop the SPOT-9 tile on "Empties go to"
  POST /api/loader/update {"id":20,"name":"UNL-A","layout":"shared_window","replenishment":"operator","funnel_windows":false,"accept_partials":false,"auto_push":false,"drain_states":[],"fed_directly":false,"pulled_directly":false,"board_hides_idle":false,"board_shows_all_parts":false,"no_clear_partials":false,"inbound_source":"GRP-B","outbound_dest":"SPOT-9"}
  GET /api/nodes
  GET /api/payloads
  GET /api/loader/list
-- drop the GRP-A-L1 (lane) tile on "Empties go to"
  (no request)
  toast warning: GRP-A-L1: a lane
-- drop the GRP-A-L1-S1 tile (its own window) on "Empties go to"
  (no request)
  toast warning: GRP-A-L1-S1: window of UNL-A
-- drop the GRP-B header on "Fulls come from" (already there)
  (no request)
-- drop a drag carrying _TRANSIT's id (no tile carries it; /api/nodes lists it) on "Empties go to"
  POST /api/loader/update {"id":20,"name":"UNL-A","layout":"shared_window","replenishment":"operator","funnel_windows":false,"accept_partials":false,"auto_push":false,"drain_states":[],"fed_directly":false,"pulled_directly":false,"board_hides_idle":false,"board_shows_all_parts":false,"no_clear_partials":false,"inbound_source":"GRP-B","outbound_dest":"_TRANSIT"}
  GET /api/nodes
  GET /api/payloads
  GET /api/loader/list

== C13: LDR-B's per-spot part picker (payloadSelect at rest, fillPayloadSelect on open)
  at rest, PART-C picked: <select class="loader-pc-sel has-payload" draggable="false"><option value="">+ payload</option><option value="PART-C" selected>PART-C</option></select>
  at rest, none picked:   <select class="loader-pc-sel" draggable="false"><option value="">+ payload</option></select>
  opened (the whole catalog, /api/payloads order), value kept "PART-C":
    "" | + payload
    "PART-B" | PART-B
    "PART-A" | PART-A
    "PART-C" | PART-C
-- pick PART-A on GRP-B-N2
  POST /api/loader/set-home {"loader_id":21,"position_node_id":7,"payload_code":"PART-A","home_kind":"home","uop_threshold":0}
  GET /api/nodes
  GET /api/payloads
  GET /api/loader/list

== C14: UNL-A's parts (payloadChipsHtml): chips, then the whole-catalog checklist
  chips: PART-B
    [x] PART-B
    [ ] PART-A
    [ ] PART-C
-- tick PART-A, untick PART-B, Save parts
  POST /api/loader/set-payload {"loader_id":20,"payload_code":"PART-A","uop_threshold":0}
  POST /api/loader/remove-payload {"loader_id":20,"payload_code":"PART-B"}
  GET /api/nodes
  GET /api/payloads
  GET /api/loader/list
